title: CrownCode AI
summary: A Claude-powered website builder with guided intake and targeted revisions.
tagline: A website builder under Higgins Digital that guides a business through a structured intake, generates a complete website package with Claude, and supports targeted revisions before deployment.
role: Designed and built the intake wizard, generation and revision flows, the package presentation, and the server-side Claude integration.
problem: People who need a website often struggle to turn their business, content, and brand preferences into a brief a developer, or a model, can act on. A single open-ended prompt produces something fast, but rarely something they can review and refine.
contribution: I designed and built the full flow: the landing page, the six-step intake wizard, the Claude generation and revision engine in server-side API routes, and the results experience with exports and a deployment guide.
solution: CrownCode collects structured requirements first (Business Basics, Brand Direction, Website Structure, Content Details, Build Preferences, and Final Review), with local auto-save so a refresh never loses answers. Each generation returns a structured package rather than raw text, and a revision step changes only what the user asks for.
solutionPoints: A package with project name, brand summary, strategy, sitemap, design system, page copy, file tree, code files, README, and a deployment guide.
Collapsible result sections, per-file copy buttons, and a full-project JSON export.
A plain-English GitHub and Vercel deployment guide for non-technical users.
A guided revision workflow for copy, layout, branding, and deployment readiness.

architecture.summary: Validated input reaches Claude only through server routes, and revisions are scoped to the requested change.
flow: Scoped revision → export and deploy guide

decisions.title: Collect structure before generating.
decisions.text: A guided intake produces a far more reviewable result than an unconstrained first prompt.

decisions.title: Keep credentials on the server.
decisions.text: The Claude integration runs in server-side routes with validated request bodies, length limits, and server-only error logging.

decisions.title: Preserve what the user didn't ask to change.
decisions.text: Revisions target the requested change and keep the rest of the package stable.

outcomes: CrownCode is live at crowncode.higginsd.com and demonstrates a guided path from business information to a website draft with supporting strategy, files, and deployment guidance.
limits: Generated sites still need human review before production. CrownCode does not claim that every generated site is automatically secure, accessible, or ready to ship.
lessons: Structured requirements and controlled revision make generated work much easier to review.
